name: Enablence Technologies Inc.
blurb: Enablence Technologies Inc. is a Canadian photonics company focused on optical chips and integrated photonics components for datacom, telecom, artificial intelligence infrastructure, automotive sensing, and LiDAR applications. The company develops planar lightwave circuit (PLC) technology used to route and split optical signals in fiber-optic networks. Its products target the intersection of growing AI compute interconnect demand and next-generation optical networking. Enablence trades in the U.S. over-the-counter market under the ticker ENAFF.
